correctness.rationale: Every primitive-three state must have one or two firings per vertex by the connected Laplacian. Explicit necessary-and-sufficient per-vertex threshold intervals give exact independent mass options for one-fire states. Their edgewise minimum and fixed maximum establish the sharp support, and chip complementation covers two-fire states. The nine-state transfer is a finite exact matrix identity, verified by symbolic rational cancellation, while direct state enumeration independently verifies small graph sizes. Infinite conclusions follow from these algebraic arguments, not finite experiments.

value.rationale: Fan graphs are a natural boundary-perturbed wheel family. The exact initially primitive-three mass distribution includes both fully saturated integer bands and a forbidden gap, a fixed-size coefficient algorithm, and an explicit double-pole rational generating function for total counts. It distinguishes open-path from cycle boundary conditions and identifies natural invariant counts beyond the generic period or density restrictions.
